SUMMARY OF DUTIES: Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an I can do that mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

At Sunrun, we're on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we're building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we're designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It's why we've become the #1 home solar and battery company in America.

We're unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle - from sale through installation and beyond - so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

Who We Are We're on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs.

Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses. Overview The Field Sales Consultant self-generates sales leads and presents in-home presentations on our solar products and services for potential customers.

Their priority is to make a genuine human connection with the potential customers with the intent to qualify and vet solar as a viable energy solution for their home and families. If you enjoy face to face interaction, engaging customers and find the idea of working out in the field exciting, then this is the job for you!

Responsibilities/The Impact Develop effective self-generated sales strategies, leads and appointments with potential customers Provide an industry leading customer sales experience from initial contact through installation and after the customer's system is turned on Conduct in-home sales presentations for potential customers and evaluate customers' knowledge and needs, building productive long lasting relationships Handle the pipeline of activity from prospect to install by following up with all leads and in-home consultations Accurately disposition and report on outcomes via our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tool Meet minimum required sales targets as set by sales leadership Qualifications/How You Will Be Successful Minimum of 1 year of sales and/or lead generation experience, with in-home sales experience preferred Must be 21 years of age, possess a valid driver's license, and maintain a clean driving record with the ability to pass a driving background check Excellent communication and teamwork skills needed to partner cross-functionally when addressing customer needs Willingness to spend time traveling within local market, depending on business needs and sales model Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, to accommodate homeowners' schedules Intermediate comfort level with technology, utilizing an IPAD/computer and multiple software applications.

(experience with a CRM is a plus) How you will be Awarded Full benefits package including health, vision, dental insurance, 401K with company match, Employee Stock Purchase Program, paid training, and much more The opportunity to invest in yourself and your career through PowerU - Sunrun's 100% tuition reimbursement program with over 150 educational opportunities A part of the Freedom Time Off (FTO) Plan - Because of the nature of our business, Sunrun cannot guarantee how much time you will be able to take away from work.

Employees on our Freedom Time Off Plan are not limited to a set number of days that they are entitled to take off from work and instead have the freedom to manage how much time off they need!

Highly competitive sales commissions paid biweekly including eligibility for bonus compensation Competitive salary plus lucrative performance incentives through our Nike/Lululemon sponsored incentive program. You'll have the opportunity to earn Nike/Lululemon swag, prizes and amazing trips. Internal advancement opportunities, as earned.

Average compensation in California (Base pay + Incentives) for the first 12 months ranges from $60,000 to $90,000 ( personal success dependent) Recruiter: Todd Cooper (todd.cooper1@sunrun.com) Please note that the compensation information is made in good faith for this position only.

It assumes that the successful candidate will be located in markets within the United States that warrant the compensation. Please speak with your recruiter to learn more. The starting salary/wage for this opportunity is in compliance with the local wage requirements. Compensation decisions will not be based on a candidate's salary history.

You can learn more here . This job description outlines the primary responsibilities, some essential job functions, and qualifications for the role. It may not include all essential functions, tasks, or requirements.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability and you need reasonable accommodation during the hiring process or to perform this role, please contact us at candidateaccommodations@sunrun.com . Sunrun is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind.

We believe that empowering people and valuing their differences are essential for our mission of connecting people to the cleanest energy on earth. Learn more here: EEO | Sunrun

Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane , and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane —a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable .
Our mission is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents . We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.
Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across 100+ countries . Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide . We’re a Series B company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital , and we’ve raised $69M to date. Learn more at upbound.io
As a Business Development Representative at Upbound , you will own early-stage pipeline generation and serve as the first touchpoint in the sales cycle. You’ll play a critical role in growing our pipeline by engaging high-intent prospects who have shown interest in Crossplane , while also sourcing and developing new opportunities through targeted outbound efforts.
In this role, you will qualify inbound leads, execute focused outbound outreach, and set up high-quality discovery conversations for the sales team. You’ll build meaningful relationships within the community, research and engage target accounts, and support events, sales operations, and special projects.

Serving as a key bridge between Marketing and Sales , your primary mission is to generate qualified pipeline and help fuel Upbound’s growth. You will report directly to the Head of BDR and work closely with both the Sales and Marketing teams.

Establish and maintain a collaborative, strategic partnership with the assigned AE’s.
Engage marketing-qualified leads, event attendees, and high-intent prospects through thoughtful, multi-channel outreach.
Target prospects through research and personalization using email, phone, LinkedIn, Slack communities, and other channels.
Research accounts within defined segments and verticals to identify target personas and generate sales-qualified leads.
Book qualified meetings with IT, engineering, and executive stakeholders for the Account Executives you support.
Have meaningful discovery conversations to understand prospect challenges and articulate the value of Crossplane and Upbound.
Outbound and source your own leads through various channels using research and creatively to book meetings.

A Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
1–2 years of experience in sales, marketing, or a related role.
Comfort operating in a technical environment; open source and/or infrastructure exposure is strongly preferred.
Hunter mentality, resourcefulness, and self-starter.
A genuine interest in building relationships, networking, and starting conversations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience using sales and marketing tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Marketo, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

You’re familiar with Crossplane and/or Upbound
Familiarity with CNCF or other open source cloud-native projects.
You’ve worked at a Series A, B or C startup

Why Upbound?
At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.
About Upbound
Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries.

The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents.

Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date.

For more information, visit www.upbound.io .

## About Outsite
Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.
## About Outsite for Teams
Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.
This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.

### 1. Prospecting & Outbound
· Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder
· Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base
· Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging
· Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages
· Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities
### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management
· Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture
· Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close
· Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged
· Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets
### 3. Collaboration & Handoff
· Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound
· Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals
· Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time
### 4. Reporting
· Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers
· Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized

· 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)
· Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders
· Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads
· Able to work autonomously and independently
· Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive
· Comfortable working European timezone hours
· Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job
· Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to
· Comfortable using AI in workflow

· Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams
· Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot
· Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space
· Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product
## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)
· A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)
· A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM
· First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed
· Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing
· Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest

· Remote, travel encouraged
· Credits for Outsite locations
· Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission

About Funden: Founders think raising capital is a relationship problem. It's actually a preparation and signal problem. Funden builds the infrastructure that makes investors come to founders: a clean, investor grade deal plus a compounding public signal, instead of chasing warm intros that rarely close.

We work with a limited number of pre seed to Series B founders at a time, by application only. We'd rather tell someone we're not a fit before they apply than after. That selectivity is the backdrop for this role. You're not talking founders into something they'll regret.

You're helping serious operators decide whether an institutional grade process is worth committing to. Location: Work from anywhere. Funden operates across San Francisco, New York, and London, and this role can be based wherever you are. Compensation: Commission only, uncapped.

Warm, pre qualified inbound plus the freedom to build your own outbound pipeline. Full commission structure, ramp expectations, and average deal economics are shared transparently on the first conversation. We'd rather you have the real numbers before you invest your time than after.

About the Role: This is a full cycle sales role focused on two things: bringing in new leads and closing the inbound ones. The majority of your pipeline is warm. Founders apply through the site, self select on stage and raise size, and arrive already interested.

You'll run the interview call, pressure test the deal alongside our team, and close the founders who are genuinely a fit. Alongside that inbound engine, you'll do outbound, sourcing founders and referral relationships that match our profile, to keep the pipeline full between cohorts. You own the conversation from first call to signed engagement.

You'll turn away founders who aren't right, because a bad fit close costs us more than a missed one. This is a commission only role. There is no base salary. The trade is straightforward: uncapped earnings, warm and pre qualified inbound, a real product with real outcomes behind it, and the autonomy to run your own pipeline.

If you close, you earn, with no ceiling on how much. Your Role Responsibility:
Run discovery and qualification calls with inbound founder applicants, pressure testing narrative, stage, and readiness against our fit criteria
Close engagements with founders who are a strong fit, and confidently disqualify those who aren't
Source outbound leads: founders and referral partners such as operators, angels, and accelerators matching the pre seed to Series B profile
Own your pipeline end to end, including forecasting, follow up, and CRM hygiene
Translate a nuanced offering (audit, deal materials, and a compounding signal system) into terms a founder can act on
Feed the team real signal from the market: which objections recur, which segments convert, what founders actually respond to

Experienced in a considered, consultative B2B sale, ideally to founders, operators, or finance literate buyers
Comfortable, energized even, by a commission only structure, because you back your own ability to close
Credible in a room with founders and investors; you can hold a substantive conversation about fundraising, deal quality, and what actually moves capital
Genuinely willing to say no to a bad fit deal, and disciplined enough to protect the brand over a short term win
Self-directed: you build your own process, manage your own pipeline, and don't wait to be told what to do next

Experience in venture, startup fundraising, M&A, investment banking, or a founder facing SaaS or fintech sale
An existing network in the early-stage startup or investor ecosystem
You've raised capital yourself, or sat close enough to the process to speak to it with authority

**Notre force et notre objectif: des programmes de formation continue et de coaching variés mettant l'accent sur les compétences professionnelles et sociales.**
Pour notre centre à **Fribourg**, nous recherchons **dès que possible, ou au plus tard au 1er novembre**, dans le cadre de notre planification de la relève, une personne pour une fonction pivot au cœur de notreprogramme qui aime allier la complexité de l'humain à celle du marché du travail en tant que :
# Coach/Conseiller.ère en Réinsertion Professionelle 80-100% #
Dans le cadre de notre programme de réadaptation professionnelle mandaté par l'Assurance-Invalidité (AI), nous accompagnons principalement des adultes qualifiés, issus de fonctions spécialisées et/ou à responsabilités, dans leur processus de réentraînement et de retour vers le premier marché du travail. Pour renforcer notre équipe de Fribourg, nous recherchons une personne capable d'allier qualité du coaching, compréhension du monde du travail, capacité d'analyse et cadre professionnel.
### Votre mission: ###
· Accompagner un retour au travail, ce qui ne consiste pas simplement à aider quelqu'un à trouver un emploi
· Aider une personne à retrouver progressivement une capacité à fonctionner dans un environnement professionnel, à identifier ses ressources et ses limites, à reconstruire des repères et à développer une manière de travailler qui soit à la fois réaliste et durable
· Allier qualité du coaching, compréhension du monde du travail, capacité d'analyse et cadre professionnel
· Soutenir sans faire à la place et encourager l'autonomie et permettre à chacun de progresser, d'expérimenter et d'apprendre de ses erreurs
· Être empathique sans perdre le cadre professionnel et écouter et comprendre les difficultés tout en gardant le focus sur les possibilités et les objectifs
· Observer avant d'interpréter et distinguer clairement les faits, les observations et les hypothèses afin de poser des constats objectifs et utiles aux décisions de réadaptation
· Comprendre le monde du travail réel et tenir compte à la fois de la personne et de son environnement professionnel, des exigences du poste, des relations de travail et des attentes de l'employeur
· Être à l'aise avec la complexité et adapter l'accompagnement à des parcours parfois non linéaires, tout en gardant les objectifs de réentrainement ligne de mire en partageant les observations et les connaissances, confronter les points de vue et solliciter un autre regard lorsque la situation le nécessite
### Votre responsabilités: ###
Vous serez responsable de l'accompagnement individuel d'un portefeuille de participants tout au long de leur mesure de réadaptation. Concrètement, vous :
· conduisez des coachings individuels réguliers et définissez avec chaque participant des objectifs de progression concrets
· observez et analysez les capacités fonctionnelles dans un contexte professionnel: organisation, rythme, autonomie, communication, gestion de la charge, interactions sociales et capacité d'adaptation
· accompagnez le développement progressif de l'autonomie et de la capacité de travail
· aidez les participants à clarifier leur projet professionnel et à préparer leur retour vers le premier marché du travail
· identifiez avec eux des opportunités de mises en situation, missions ou stages auprès d'entreprises

About AirOps
AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Buyers now rely on agents to discover, recommend, and purchase products and services for them. If your brand isn't part of the answer, you aren't in the running.
Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.
Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.

AirOps is opening its first dedicated EMEA sales development role at a moment when AI-driven content discovery is reshaping how European brands compete. You will own the full outbound motion across EMEA, prospecting into marketing and growth teams in the UK, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, France, Southern Europe, and beyond. This is not a UK-only seat.
You will build pipeline across multiple markets, navigating different buying cultures and business contexts every day. You'll work cross-functionally with Sales and GTM Engineering to turn intent signals into qualified discovery calls that map prospect pain to our AI capabilities.

Based hybrid out of our central London office, you are the first face of AirOps for EMEA buyers. The role reports into our Sales leadership and carries a direct line to how quickly we scale internationally. If you want a front-row seat to building a region from scratch, this is it.

Build the Engine: As one of the founding EMEA SDRs, you'll develop and execute creative outreach strategies that don't just hit targets, they crush them. You'll be the one finding the "needles in the haystack" and turning them into qualified pipeline.
Be an AI Matchmaker: Conduct discovery calls that act as deep-dive consultations. Your goal is to map prospect pain points to our AI capabilities, not just read a script.
Own the First Impression: You are the first face of AirOps. You’ll build authentic, high-trust relationships with key decision-makers before they even realize they need a better workflow.
Pass the Torch: Work in lockstep with our Account Executives to ensure that every handoff is seamless, qualified, and set up for a closed-won win.
The "Data Artist": Keep our CRM (our "Source of Truth") clean, organized, and actionable. We value data-driven iteration—if an email template isn't working, iterate, A/B test, and optimize until it does.
Startup Speed: In a high-growth environment, agility is your superpower. Whether you're troubleshooting a new outreach tool or jumping on a last-minute demo, you thrive on the "all-hands-on-deck" pace.

The "Hungry" Factor: 0-1 years of B2B SaaS sales experience. If you’ve got the grit, we’ll provide the roadmap. Bonus points if you’ve spent time in the marketing or growth-tech trenches.
Outreach Ninja: Whether it's a cold call, a hyper-personalized email, or a strategic LinkedIn connection, you know how to cut through the noise without sounding like a bot.
High EQ & Active Listening: You know that discovery is 80% listening and 20% speaking. You have the empathy to understand a prospect's frustrations and the communication skills to offer the solution.
Bias for Action: You are just as comfortable running solo on a new project as you are jumping into a team brainstorming session. You own your outcomes.
A Track Record of "Done": Whether it’s a side project, a degree, or a previous job, you have a history of starting things and actually finishing them.
The Vibe-Coder Mindset: We build with AI, and we want you to understand it. Experience coding, scripting, or playing around with "vibe-coding" platforms (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, etc.) is a massive plus. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you've ideally gone beyond simply using LLMs as research and content-generation tools.
Nice to have: Fluent in a European language beyond English. German, French, Spanish, Dutch, or a Nordic language would open doors across key EMEA markets.
